messages.text: Hi

Your future self is built by the habits you start today—let’s make every moment count. Consistency beats intensity.

Tasks:  
1. Study – Review lecture notes from your last class, summarizing key points in your own words (30 minutes)  
2. Skill – Practice a relevant problem or exercise related to your current subject (20 minutes)  
3. Habit – Set a fixed study time for tomorrow and prepare your study space now (10 minutes)  

Suggested study technique: Use the Pomodoro method—25 minutes focused work, 5 minutes break—to maintain sharp concentration.
